title: Hostelworld Reviews

startUrls.title: Hostelworld property URLs
startUrls.description: Hostelworld property pages, e.g. ["https://www.hostelworld.com/hostels/p/15529/home-lisbon-hostel/"] (the older hosteldetails.php form works too). Every URL form carries the numeric property id, so no page is loaded first. Use for "reviews of this hostel". A URL from another site ends the run with the reason on the run card and nothing charged. One of startUrls or propertyIds is required.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Hostelworld property URLs and/or Hostelworld's numeric property ids; one of the two is required. A URL and its id are the same hostel, harvested once.

propertyIds.title: Hostelworld property ids
propertyIds.description: Hostelworld's numeric property ids, e.g. ["15529", "1150"]: the number in /hostels/p/<id>/ and the property_id on an earlier run's rows. The fastest input for scheduled runs over a known list. An id Hostelworld no longer serves costs nothing and is reported as a status row with status "not_found". One of startUrls or propertyIds is required.

maxReviewsPerProperty.title: Max reviews per hostel
maxReviewsPerProperty.description: Reviews fetched per hostel in reviewsSort order, e.g. 50 (default 100). 0 = every review the hostel has (Hostelworld pages them 50 at a time; a busy hostel has a few thousand, i.e. several dollars). The main cost control: at most N x $0.004 per hostel. minRating, maxRating, groupTypes, sinceDate and requireText apply to these N fetched rows, so set 0 to scan a whole history; for "the 20 worst reviews" set 20 with reviewsSort "rating".
maxReviewsPerProperty.sectionDescription: How many reviews per hostel, in which order, and which are worth paying for. Every filter here runs before billing: a filtered review is never charged.

reviewsSort.title: Review order
reviewsSort.description: The order Hostelworld returns reviews in: "-date" (default, newest first; the only order in which sinceDate stops paging early), "date" (oldest first), "rating" (lowest rated first: use with a small maxReviewsPerProperty for "the worst reviews" or a complaints feed), "-rating" (highest rated first). These four are the only values the API honours.

sinceDate.title: Only reviews published on or after
sinceDate.description: Empty (default) = no date limit. "2026-09-01" (YYYY-MM-DD) or relative to the day the run starts: "30 days", "2 weeks", "6 months". Use for "only new reviews" on a schedule: with the default newest-first order the run stops reading once a whole page predates the date, so a daily run reads one page per hostel. Older reviews are never billed.

maxRating.title: Only reviews at or below this score
maxRating.description: 0 (default) = no ceiling. 1-100 = keep only reviews whose 0-100 overall score is at or below it, e.g. 70 for "negative reviews", "complaints", "what guests disliked" (rating_5 = score / 20, so 70 is 3.5 stars). Combine with reviewsSort "rating" so the worst arrive first. Applied to the rows fetched, before billing; filtered reviews are never billed.

minRating.title: Only reviews at or above this score
minRating.description: 0 (default) = no floor. 1-100 = keep only reviews scored at or above it, e.g. 90 for "praise", "the raves", quotes for marketing. Combine with maxRating for a band (minRating must not be above maxRating). Applied before billing; filtered reviews are never billed.

groupTypes.title: Who was travelling
groupTypes.description: Empty (default) = every guest. Otherwise keep only these group types, e.g. ["FEMALE"] for "what solo female travellers say": MALE and FEMALE (solo travellers), COUPLE, ALLFEMALEGROUP, ALLMALEGROUP, MIXEDGROUP, FAMILY; friendly spellings work (solo_female, female_group, mixed_group, couples, family). Hostelworld has no server-side filter, so the pages are still read; filtered reviews are never billed.

requireText.title: Only reviews with a written text
requireText.description: false (default) = every review. true = drop score-only reviews (empty text) before billing. Hostelworld reviews nearly always carry a sentence or two, so this rarely removes much; set it when every billed row must carry text.

includePropertyRow.title: Include a hostel row
includePropertyRow.description: true (DEFAULT) = one free row per hostel (type "property") with name, type, city, country, address, coordinates, star rating, aggregate 0-100 score and sub-ratings, total ratings, facilities, what it is best for, lowest nightly price and the solo/couples/groups split of reviewers. No charge; the record is read either way (it names the review rows). false = review and status rows only.

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Proxy sessions (egress IPs) run in parallel, 1-16, e.g. 2 (default 2). More is faster; each session is paced separately.
sessions.sectionDescription: Leave these alone unless a run is being throttled.

perIp.title: Requests per second per session
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1-5, e.g. 1 (default 1). Hostelworld's API answered 10 of 10 at 1/s from one datacenter IP; 1-2 is comfortable.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy datacenter group is enough and is the default: Hostelworld's public JSON API answers plain requests with no key, no login and no bot gate. Residential works too and costs more.

description: Hostelworld hostel reviews. Minimal input: {"propertyIds": ["15529"]} or {"startUrls": ["https://www.hostelworld.com/hostels/p/15529/home-lisbon-hostel/"]}; one of the two is required. maxReviewsPerProperty defaults to 100 at $0.004 per review delivered; includePropertyRow defaults to true and is free. minRating, maxRating, groupTypes, sinceDate and requireText filter BEFORE billing. Review text is Hostelworld's single machine-translated English set.
